meta.name: gpt-image-2
meta.description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0) on RunComfy. Documents GPT Image 2's strengths (embedded text, logos, multilingual typography, instruction precision), its 3 fixed sizes, edit-with-preservation language, and when to route to a sibling (Flux 2 / Nano Banana Pro / Seedream) instead. Calls `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/text-to-image` or `/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "gpt image 2", "gpt-image-2", "ChatGPT Images 2", "image 2", or any explicit ask to generate or edit with this model.

copy.tagline: 用GPT Image 2生成和编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用GPT Image 2模型生成或编辑图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with GPT Image 2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or edit images using the GPT Image 2 model

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 RunComfy CLI 调用 OpenAI GPT Image 2 模型生成或编辑图片。它擅长在图片中嵌入文字、标志和多语言排版，并能精确遵循多元素指令。
howto.when: 当用户提到“gpt image 2”、“gpt-image-2”、“ChatGPT Images 2”、“image 2”等关键词，或明确要求使用该模型生成或编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 用 GPT Image 2 生成一张产品图，瓶子上写“AQUA+”。
编辑这张图片，把背景换成白色，保持主体不变。
say.note: Claude 会调用 edit 端点，并尝试保持主体不变。

say.text: 生成一张东京咖啡馆的招牌，上面写“コーヒー”。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含日文文字的图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images using OpenAI GPT Image 2 via the RunComfy CLI. It excels at embedding text, logos, and multilingual typography, and precisely follows multi-element prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "gpt image 2", "gpt-image-2", "ChatGPT Images 2", "image 2", or explicitly asks to generate or edit images with this model.

say_en.text: Generate a product image with "AQUA+" on the bottle using GPT Image 2.
say_en.note: Claude will call the text-to-image endpoint.

say_en.text: Edit this image, change the background to white, keep the subject unchanged.
say_en.note: Claude will call the edit endpoint and attempt to preserve the subject.

say_en.text: Generate a Tokyo café storefront sign that reads "コーヒー".
say_en.note: Claude will generate an image with Japanese text.
